---
title: "Combined UMAP + VAE DPS Visualization"
subtitle: "Side-by-side comparison of Path2D DPS across methods and thresholds"
---

## Overview

This document combines DPS results from UMAP and VAE lite analyses, producing heatmaps, line plots, and bar charts that compare both methods across thresholds 7 and 8.

## Load Packages

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

pacman::p_load(patchwork, install = FALSE)
conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
```

## Load Data

Load DPS results from both methods and both thresholds, add method labels, create generic dimension pair labels by stripping method prefix, and bind into a single tibble.

```{r}
#| label: load-data

methods <- list(
  UMAP = list(
    path_template = \(th) here(glue("UMAP/lite/output/dps_results_threshold_{th}.rds")),
    col_prefix = "umap_"
  ),
  VAE = list(
    path_template = \(th) here(glue("VAE/lite/DPS/output/dps_results_threshold_{th}.rds")),
    col_prefix = "vae_"
  )
)

thresholds <- c(8, 7)

dps_all <- map(names(methods), \(method) {
  info <- methods[[method]]
  map(thresholds, \(th) {
    read_rds(info$path_template(th)) |>
      mutate(
        method = method,
        threshold = th,
        method_threshold = glue("{method} Thr {th}"),
        dim_pair_label = glue(
          "dim_{str_remove(dimx, paste0('^', info$col_prefix))} vs dim_{str_remove(dimy, paste0('^', info$col_prefix))}"
        )
      )
  }) |>
    list_rbind()
}) |>
  list_rbind()

glimpse(dps_all)
```

## Plot 1: DPS Heatmap

DPS values ranked by performance across all four method-threshold combinations, with tile labels showing the dimension pair and DPS value.

```{r}
#| label: fig-dps-heatmap
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 5

plot_heatmap <- dps_all |>
  mutate(
    tile_label = paste0(dim_pair_label, "\n", sprintf("%.2f", path2d_dps))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = dps_rank, y = method_threshold, fill = path2d_dps)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = tile_label), size = 2.5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166ac", mid = "white", high = "#b2182b",
    midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), name = "Path2D DPS"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:15, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    x = "Dimension Pair Rank (1 = Highest DPS)",
    y = "Method / Threshold"
  )

plot_heatmap
```

## Plot 2: DPS Line Plot

DPS decay across ranked dimension pairs for each method-threshold combination, with line type distinguishing methods.

```{r}
#| label: fig-dps-line
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

plot_line <- dps_all |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = dps_rank, y = path2d_dps,
    color = method_threshold, linetype = method
  )) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(UMAP = "solid", VAE = "dashed")) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Method / Threshold") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:15) +
  labs(
    x = "Dimension Pair Rank (1 = Highest DPS)",
    y = "Path2D DPS",
    linetype = "Method"
  )

plot_line
```

## Plot 3: DPS Bar Chart

Bar chart of DPS values per dimension pair, faceted by method-threshold with independent x-axis ordering per panel.

```{r}
#| label: fig-dps-bar
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 10

plot_bar <- dps_all |>
  mutate(
    dim_key = paste(method, threshold, dim_pair_label, sep = "___"),
    dim_key = reorder(dim_key, -dps_rank)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = dim_key, y = path2d_dps, fill = path2d_dps)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166ac", mid = "white", high = "#b2182b",
    midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), name = "Path2D DPS"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = \(x) str_remove(x, "^.*___")) +
  facet_wrap(~ method_threshold, ncol = 2, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    x = "Dimension Pair",
    y = "Path2D DPS"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

plot_bar
```

## Save Outputs

Save all three plots as PNG and RDS, plus the combined DPS tibble.

```{r}
#| label: save-outputs

output_dir <- here("VAE_UMAP_comb/output")
fs::dir_create(output_dir)

plots <- list(
  fig_dps_heatmap = list(plot = plot_heatmap, w = 14, h = 5),
  fig_dps_line = list(plot = plot_line, w = 10, h = 5),
  fig_dps_bar = list(plot = plot_bar, w = 12, h = 10)
)

iwalk(plots, \(spec, nm) {
  ggsave(
    here(output_dir, glue("{nm}.png")),
    spec$plot, width = spec$w, height = spec$h, dpi = 300,
    bg = "white", device = ragg::agg_png
  )
  write_rds(spec$plot, here(output_dir, glue("{nm}.rds")))
})

write_rds(dps_all, here(output_dir, "dps_all.rds"))
```
